purpose: Teach: 薪/館内/本館/防音/農作業/手洗い/補習/弾ける

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ストーブの薪、お父さん、運んでくれた。
lines.en: Mom — Dad carried all the firewood for the stove.
lines.style: Bright, observant child reporting a small fact he's noticed. Quick, clear delivery. Pride in the detail. Slight lift at the end, like he's waiting to see if it matters to her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。図書館の館内、しっかり静かにね。
lines.en: Yes. We need to keep the library nice and quiet, okay?
lines.style: Gentle mother-voice. Not commanding, but matter-of-fact. A soft landing on the expectation. Warm underneath the direction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 本館に、図書、たくさんあるんだよね。
lines.en: The main building has so many books, doesn't it?
lines.style: Child's wonder at discovery. Open, animated voice. Each phrase lands with genuine interest. Seeking confirmation of something he's just realized.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ピアノの練習、防音マット、買ったのよ。
lines.en: We bought a soundproof mat for your piano practice.
lines.style: Quiet pride in a small thoughtfulness. Soft attack. Steady, warm tone. The kind of thing she mentions almost in passing, but it's been planned.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃんち、農作業、手伝うのが楽しみ。
lines.en: Helping Grandpa with the farm work — I can't wait.
lines.style: Genuine eagerness. Anticipatory rhythm, like he's already imagining it. Small-child earnestness. The kind of thing that makes adults remember why they loved being that age.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お外から帰ったら、手洗いね、必ず。
lines.en: When you come in from outside, you have to wash your hands — every time.
lines.style: Patient, practical direction from a mother who's said this before and will say it again. Calm, consistent tone. No heat in it, just steady care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夏休みの補習、皆と一緒だから、楽しい。
lines.en: Summer remedial lessons with all your friends — that's going to be fun.
lines.style: Mild reassurance dressed as observation. Mother normalizing something that might have worried him. Warm, matter-of-fact. The comfort in her certainty.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祭りで、風船、たくさん弾けるのを見て、笑ったね。
lines.en: I watched you at the festival popping all those balloons and laughing — it made me so happy.
lines.style: Tender memory spoken close. Slow, lingering tone. The kind of moment a mother holds and brings back because it mattered. Warm eye-contact level, present tense affection.
